answer: Sybil resistance follows from an exponentially decaying reputation score with a fixed half-life: past trust fades unless an identity sustains honest service over time. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted incoming paths, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero and it cannot meet consensus thresholds. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed influence; the glacier of accumulated trust must be earned, not forged, and mirror identities do not create independent endorsement.
